notes: AI-specific security/test ownership remains in its local checker; common family invariants and capability ownership are composed first.

dependency_edges.rationale: In package mode the proxy imports the page-feedback request contract and service from the sibling extension; a standalone Space deployment falls back to the byte-identical mirror in _hf_spaces_proxy/_page_feedback, so the import is optional at runtime.

capability_ownership.description: Browser presentation remains subordinate to server-side credentials, routing, persistence, and security policy.
Build-time canonical page representation and its controlled runtime consumption boundary.
